system.description:
The Guild is the continent-wide network out of Opal; many members worship Mask. The Owl runs everything through Ravens, and Crows carry out the high-value work. Knowing who to kill and why is half the job.

  • Sanctioned Strike: a target named in a Guild contract, or one you have a Dossier on, has Disadvantage on its Death Attack save.
    • 9th level: your first Sneak Attack each encounter against that target deals one extra Sneak Attack die.
  • Crow's Papers: Advantage on Case Target checks when a Raven or Crow superior has given you the target's dossier, and you are recognised on sight by other Guild members as a Crow.
